paper.title_en: Dirichlet walls and the end of time
paper.abstract_en: We study evolution in Einstein-Hilbert gravity with Dirichlet boundary conditions imposed on a finite surface. We argue that there are open sets of initial data where such evolutions terminate at finite times due to singularities that reach the boundary. In any dimension, the simplest such examples occur in cosmologies. However, in 2+1 dimensions we also show that Dirichlet walls initially outside a BTZ black hole can fall through the horizon, and that this also leads to generic singularities. A similar construction in higher dimensions leads to trapped surfaces that reach the wall, though the end result of such evolutions is more difficult to study.

decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在有限曲面上施加Dirichlet边界条件的Einstein-Hilbert引力中的演化。我们论证存在开集初始数据，使得此类演化因到达边界的奇点而在有限时间内终止。在任何维度中，最简单的此类例子出现在宇宙学中。然而，在2+1维中，我们还表明，最初位于BTZ黑洞之外的Dirichlet墙可以落入视界，并且这也会导致一般的奇点。在高维中类似的构造会导致到达墙的俘获面，尽管此类演化的最终结果更难以研究。
